title: Rights, License & Use-Capability Matrix
objective: Record evidence for private use, transform, campaign use, export, redistribution, commercial use and unknown/denied/revoked states. Downstream systems must filter actions through these capabilities.

matching_red.reason: Focused ARI-11 regression/profile existed while the production rights/license/use-capability module was intentionally absent; exact-head Linux client typecheck failed with TS2307 for rights-license-use-capability-matrix.

completion_summary: Implemented a deterministic evidence-backed rights/license/use-capability matrix for private use, transform, campaign use, export, redistribution and commercial use. Every capability defaults to unknown, only explicit allowed evidence permits downstream actions, denied/revoked evidence remains blocking, conflicts resolve restrictively while staying explicit, source/import existence never grants rights, and ARI-12/provider/distribution/release authority remains outside the tranche.
